# selfdoc.js.loader

Loads JavaScript source files from the `selfdoc.js` package using `importlib.resources`, providing a clean interface for the HTML renderer to embed theme toggles, search dialogs, and other interactive features. The `load_js` function reads a single named JS file, while `load_search_js` composes the search dialog by combining an engine-specific implementation (builtin, fuse, or minisearch) with the shared dialog UI code.

This module centralizes all JS file access so the rest of selfdoc never constructs file paths to JS assets directly.
